reason: I have never paid for an app and I won't start now. If the free part works offline and doesn't eat our internet, maybe I'll download it, but the child can learn letters from YouTube and the kindergarten for free.
objection: The app is probably big and our internet is slow and limited, so even downloading it costs me; paying 25 thousand every month on top of that for a phone game is too much.
would_change_my_mind: If other parents in our kindergarten Telegram group used it and said the free part was not enough and PRO really got the child ready for school, and it was a one-time small payment instead of monthly.
